default.shell:
---

{{ if .Vars.win19cis_level_1 }}
  {{ if .Vars.win19cis_rule_9_2_1 }}
registry:
  HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\WindowsFirewall\PrivateProfile\EnableFirewall:
    title: "9.2.1 | Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Firewall state' is set to 'On (recommended)' | EnableFirewall"
    exists: true
    value: 1
    type: REG_DWORD
    meta:
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 9.2.1
      NIST800-53R5:
        - SC-7
        - SC-7(5)
file:
  win19cis_9_2_1_effective:
    title: "9.2.1 | Ensure 'Windows Firewall: Private: Firewall state' is set to 'On (recommended)' | effective"
    path: '{{ .Vars.win19cis_snapshot_dir }}\Firewall.Private.Enabled'
    exists: true
    contents:
      - '/^True$/'
    meta:
      domaincontroller: 1
      memberserver: 1
      server: 1
      CIS_ID:
        - 9.2.1
      NIST800-53R5:
        - SC-7
        - SC-7(5)
  {{ end }}
{{ end }}
